file_stem: RWB E1 015 Freshness stamp per data product
title: Freshness stamp per data product
status_text: Ready. Whole feature waits for RWB-ACE-001
goal: Stamp each data product with its ACE batch age, flag stale data, and hold daily jobs until sources complete
why: Users and decisions must know how old the data is. Freshness comes only from ACE's batch record, never from data_as_of.
triggers: Cut-off check per product at expected_by

writes.note: one stamp per product: LOADED or STALE, age in days

stores: Events EV-26 AceDataReady and EV-27 AceDataLate; operations alert; one Quartz trigger per product

functions.name: FreshnessStampService
functions.does: write stamp, set or clear STALE

functions.name: DailyCompletenessGateImpl
functions.does: COMPLETE or HOLD for a job

rules: BR4: a multi-source product takes the oldest date (DP06 = CCMS, SVAF, AMIS, RPS)
BR5: every decision records the stamps it read in inputs_ref
BR8: no daily job starts until its sources are COMPLETED
BR9: freshness comes only from v_ace_batch_status, never from data_as_of
risks: No COMPLETED batch by expected_by -> STALE + EV-27 AceDataLate (MSG-P1-001)
FAILED batch -> STALE at once, previous stamp kept (MSG-P1-001)
Same batch row read twice -> duplicate_count + 1, no second event
example: -> DP01 LOADED, ageDays 1, EV-26 -> JOB-02, 04, 07 and 08 start
If ALS is still missing at 08:00 on 2026-12-01 -> DP01 STALE + EV-27
